def process_data(row):

    text = row['sentences']
    text = str(text)
    text = ' '.join(text.split())

    encodings = tokenizer(text, padding="max_length", truncation=True, max_length=128)

    label = 0
    if row['ADR'] == 1:
        label += 1

    encodings['label'] = label
    encodings['text'] = text

    return encodings

# --- [CELL 10]: ---

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
